mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "top-games" lists trending games/categories by viewer count. "top-streams" lists the platform-wide top live streams. "game-streams" lists the top live channels within a specific game/category. "channel-rank" checks whether specific channel(s) are currently trending, with their approximate rank platform-wide and within their category.

limit.title: Max items
limit.description: "top-games"/"top-streams"/"game-streams" mode -- how many results to return. Twitch enforces a hard per-page ceiling for HTTP-only clients (30 for streams, 100 for games) -- see README for why deeper pagination isn't available.

gameName.title: Game/category name
gameName.description: "game-streams" mode -- the exact game/category name as it appears on Twitch (e.g. "Just Chatting", "League of Legends").

gameNames.title: Game/category names
gameNames.description: "game-streams" mode only -- multiple game/category names to fetch in one run.

login.title: Channel login
login.description: "channel-rank" mode -- a single Twitch channel login to check.

logins.title: Channel logins
logins.description: "channel-rank" mode only -- multiple channel logins to check in one run.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: "game-streams"/"channel-rank" mode -- how many games/channels to process in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
